mom252_21.definition: ln(C[21]/C[252]): 12-month return skipping the last month

mom126_21.definition: ln(C[21]/C[126]): 6-month return skipping the last month

mom63_5.definition: ln(C[5]/C[63]): 3-month return skipping the last week

resmom252_21.definition: mom252_21 minus beta252 * SPY's mom252_21 (beta-adjusted, 'residual' momentum)

accel.definition: mom126_21 minus ln(C[126]/C[252]): recent half-year minus the half-year before

posmonths12.definition: number of the last 12 21-bar blocks with a positive return (consistency)

hi252.definition: C / highest(H, 252): closeness to the 52-week high

hi252c.definition: C / highest(C, 252): closeness to the highest close (neighbour)

barshi252.definition: bars since the highest high of 252 bars

nh63.definition: number of bars in the last 63 on which H made a new 252-bar high

lo252.definition: C / lowest(L, 252): distance above the 52-week low

d200.definition: ln(C / sma(C,200)) / (vol * sqrt(200)), vol = Study.vol (robust EWMA, span 20)

minervini.definition: 1 if C>sma50>sma150>sma200 and sma200>sma200[21] and C>=1.3*lowest(L,252) and C>=0.75*highest(H,252), else 0

above50_126.definition: share of the last 126 bars with C > sma(C,50)

r2s63.definition: signed R-squared of ln(C) on time over 63 bars (sign of the slope). The slope's t-statistic is a monotone transform, so it has the same quantiles

r2s126.definition: signed R-squared of ln(C) on time over 126 bars

tstat126.definition: t-statistic of the 126-bar log-price regression slope: r*sqrt(124/(1-r^2))

slopeR2_126.definition: annualised 126-bar regression slope of ln(C) times its R-squared (Clenow)

id252.definition: information discreteness: sign(mom252_21) * (share of down days - share of up days) over bars t-252..t-21; negative = smooth trend (Da, Gurun, Warachka 2014)

sharpe126.definition: ln(C/C[126]) / (stdev(daily log ret,126)*sqrt(126)): return per unit of volatility

sharpe252_21.definition: mom252_21 / (stdev(daily log ret,231)[21]*sqrt(231)): 12-1 return per unit of volatility

er126.definition: signed efficiency ratio: ln(C/C[126]) / sum(|daily log ret|, 126) (Kaufman)

upfrac126.definition: share of up days over 126 bars

rsline252.definition: (C/SPY) / highest(C/SPY, 252): closeness of the relative-strength line to its 52-week high
